items.source: /// Container names from a `docker ps --format {{.Names}}` listing.

items.name: parse_names
items.source:
fn parse_names(rendered: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    rendered
        .lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter(|name| !name.is_empty())
        .map(str::to_string)
        .collect()
}
